cards.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

cards.name: Dratini

attacks.name: Hypnotic Gaze
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It is called the "Mirage Pokémon" because so few have seen it. Its shed skin has been found.

cards.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

cards.flavorText: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

cards.name: Dragonair

attacks.name: Healing Melody
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

cards.name: Dragonite

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hurricane Tail
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 60 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

cards.name: Shelgon

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

cards.name: Salamence

abilities.name: Scornful Storm
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent discard cards from his or her hand until he or she has 4 cards left in his or her hand.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

cards.name: Latias

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sky Heal
attacks.text: If Latios is on your Bench, heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its body is covered in a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

cards.name: Latios

attacks.name: Sky Blade
attacks.text: If Latias is on your Bench, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

cards.name: Rayquaza

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

cards.name: Axew

attacks.name: Signs of Evolution
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for Fraxure, reveal it, and put it into your hand, Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Axew

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

cards.name: Fraxure

abilities.name: Grit
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, each of its attacks does 40 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

cards.name: Fraxure
cards.flavorText: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

cards.name: Haxorus

attacks.name: Axe Slugger
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Colorless Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck.

cards.flavorText: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

cards.name: Druddigon

attacks.name: Tight Jaw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Dragon Tail
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

cards.name: Kyurem

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.
